translations.web: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
translations.bsb: The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years were complete. This is the first resurrection.
translations.kjv: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
translations.asv: The rest of the dead lived not until the thousand years should be finished. This is the first resurrection.
